title: Loom Surface Stream v1
description: Response envelope of the daemon's surface stream poll. `protocolVersion` is required, not optional: Hook rejects an envelope that omits it rather than treating the peer as a legacy daemon, so a build that drops the field looks like a protocol mismatch instead of an older version.

next.description: Cursor to pass as `after` on the next poll.

reset.description: True when the hub dropped messages the client had not read yet, so the client must treat the batch as a fresh start rather than a continuation.

messages.description: Surface messages in delivery order. Each entry is a Surface Message v1 bridge event; see surface-message.v1.schema.json for the per-method payloads.
